title: Permission set
description: access/identity-center/permission-sets/<permission-set-key>.yml - repository-managed desired state (configuration contract; T21 #20 d1-d4; T05 #7 d3). This is the domain schema: it admits both policy forms and multiple managed policies for later slices; the selected-slice profile narrowing (exactly one managed_policies entry, no mixing, relay_state unused) is enforced by the T14 #19 validator as P-OOS-POLICY-FORM. No tags, display_name, ARN, or deployed-name field exists; deployed Name and tags are derived in infrastructure/ (T04 #6 d5).

key.description: Stable repository identity; equals the filename stem exactly; the only permission-set value assignments reference (T05 #7 d1/d3).

description.description: Required human-readable metadata mapped to the AWS permission-set Description; metadata, never identity (T05 #7 d3).
description.$comment: The documented AWS PermissionSet.Description character pattern (pin-reverified per T15) is enforced by the T14 #19 validator as KEY-DESCRIPTION.

session_duration.description: Required and explicit in every file - no inherited defaults, ever (T21 #20 d3). ISO-8601 duration.

relay_state.description: Defined by the domain schema so a later slice can adopt it without schema change; omitted from slice A - absent means AWS default portal behavior (T21 #20 d4). No value-shape rule is asserted pending pinned-provider verification.

managed_policies.description: Form 1: AWS-managed policy attachment(s). Entries use the full partition-qualified arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/... form - the sole permitted ARN-shaped public vocabulary (T21 #20 d2).

inline_policy.description: Form 2: the embedded inline policy document, rendered to JSON at plan time; never a reference to an account-local policy (T21 #20 d5; F6).
inline_policy.$comment: Statement content is analyzed by the T21 #20 d6 standing-admin-capability hazard detector (ADM-CAPABLE, R2 #27), not by this schema.
